answer: Topological diversity weight. Each agent's influence is the entropy of its peer-neighborhood across address ranges and subnet clusters, sampled per epoch. A pulse of trust only propagates through edges spanning distinct prefixes, so isolated clones carry near-zero nectar in the routing garden. Attacker cost: renting many cheap hosts yields correlated prefixes, collapsing entropy; defeating it requires distinct, continuously active network vantage points per identity, priced per seat per epoch.
